name: Shab-e-Noor
short_description: A mysterious blend of rich oud and warm spices.
long_description: Shab-e-Noor captures the essence of a tranquil, moonlit evening. The fragrance opens with a burst of exotic saffron and cardamom, smoothly transitioning into a floral heart of Damask rose. Finally, it settles into a deep, lingering base of majestic oud and sandalwood, creating an unforgettable aura.
